nemotron-speech-en-0-6b.description: Transcribe a complete uploaded recording. Upload and finalize audio first; no local path, URL, base64, or file bytes belong in MCP arguments. Large recordings use the returned durable operation.

audio.description: Small caller-owned artifact reference returned by finalize_model_artifact_upload.

artifact_id.description: Finalized artifact UUID belonging to the caller's tenant.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the uploaded file bytes.

size_bytes.description: Exact encoded file size, at most 512 MiB.

media_type.description: Audio or audio-bearing video MIME type.

compression.description: No artifact-layer compression; audio codec compression is accepted.

model.description: The exact App runtime selected by this tool.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language/locale hint, or auto for the multilingual App. Eight adaptation-only locales are not enabled.

chunk_size_ms.title: Chunk Size Ms
chunk_size_ms.description: Streaming chunk size in milliseconds; must match the App's configured worker profile. This is not an end-to-end latency promise.

strip_language_tags.title: Strip Language Tags
strip_language_tags.description: Whether to remove multilingual language tags; must match the configured worker profile.

output_granularity.title: Output Granularity
output_granularity.description: Requested native segment or word metadata. Returned timestamps must come from the runtime, not wall-clock inference.

stop_history_eou_ms.title: Stop History Eou Ms
stop_history_eou_ms.description: Endpoint-history cutoff in milliseconds after an end-of-utterance marker.

options.title: SpeechOptions
options.description: Model-specific transcription options. Runtime-wide settings must match the App profile; language and output granularity are per request.
